## 💡 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature or enhancement you would like to propose.

## 🎯 Problem / Motivation
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? Please describe. 
*(e.g., "Municipal officers need automated SMS alerts when high-severity illegal dumps are detected in Ward 4.")*

## 🚀 Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision the feature working, including any UI changes, API endpoints, or model adjustments.

## 🎨 UI / UX Mockups (Optional)
If applicable, attach design sketches, wireframes, or screenshots.

## 🛠️ Alternative Approaches
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📌 Target Subsystem
- [ ] Backend API & AI Pipeline
- [ ] Landing Page & Public Visualizer
- [ ] Citizen Reporting App
- [ ] Municipal Command Center Dashboard
- [ ] GIS & Route Optimization Engine
